questions.question: 16 workers can complete a piece of work in 98 days. They start working together and after 28 days 12 more workers join them. In how many days in all will the work be completed?
questions.questionHtml: 16 workers can complete a piece of work in 98 days. They start working together and after 28 days 12 more workers join them. In how many days in all will the work be completed?
questions.solution:
let x=no. of days taken when 12 extra workers joined

16 × 98 = 28 × 16 + 28x

28x=16 × 70

x = 40

Total number of days taken = 40 + 28 = 68 days

questions.questionHtml: The external dimensions of a box are 15 cm, 17 cm and 22 cm. Its thickness is 2 cm. If a cubic cm of metal used in the box weighs 1 gms, Find the approximate weight of the box (in KG)
questions.solution:
Volume of outer surface = 15 *17 *22 = 5610

Volume of inner surface = 11*13*18 = 2574

Weight = (5610-2574) /1000 = 3.036

questions.question: The number 14695326228 is:
questions.questionHtml: The number 14695326228 is:
questions.solution:
The number 14695326228 is divisible by both 6 and 11.

=> (1+6+5+2+2+8) - (4+9+3+6+2) = 0/11/multiple of 11

=> 24-24 = 0

Also, 1+4+6+9+5+3+2+6+2+2+8 = 48

It is divisible by 2 and 3.

∴14695326228 is divisible by both 6 and 11.
